name: Forward Knuckleplate
description: Snap the leading fist straight out so the brass face lands flush on the target's chin or chest.

name: Palmbar Drop
description: Turn the raised boss of the metal onto the sternum and drive a short jab through that single point.

name: Raised Fistbar
description: Raise the ringed forearm outward and let the brass knock a straight punch off its line.

name: Skipping Studplate
description: Slide the rear foot back half a pace with the fist held at the chin, opening safe distance.

name: Ringlid
description: Tuck both elbows to the ribs and close the brass fists before the face to weather a rush.

name: Ringcowl
description: Press the brass against the opponent's wrist as they reach, then shove it off line to spoil the grab.

name: Ringdash
description: With the fingers fully seated in the rings and the wrist locked, jab the brass into the cheek.

name: Gnawing Brassrim
description: Whip the rear fist across with the wrist locked so the brass lands square on the jaw hinge.

name: Overhand Pause
description: Heel the palm bar into the opponent's shoulder and push, breaking their forward balance before they strike.

name: Ringbump
description: Drag the edge of the ring down a reaching forearm until the stung hand lets go.

name: Light Brawl
description: Plant the lead knuckles against the target and swing the hips round them to step off the line.

name: Ringhusk
description: Close the open hand over the brass-fisted one and catch a straight punch against the cupped palm.

name: Hooding Ringband
description: Reseat the rings with a flick of the fingers while the free forearm holds the guard across the face.

name: Lowered Knuckleridge
description: Hold both brass fists against the cheekbones with the elbows tight so blows land on the forearms.

name: Slabblow
description: Slip the head inside a straight blow, step in half a pace and jab the brass into the ribs.

name: Lowered Brassring
description: Drop the elbow to meet a body hook so the forearm brass turns the blow aside.

name: Handfill Cowl
description: Tap the brass sharply on the inside of a gripping wrist to break the clinch before it settles.

name: Light Hooking
description: Slide back half a pace on the balls of both feet, keeping the cover tight while distance reopens.

name: Firm Brawl
description: Swing the fist in a flat loop from the shoulder so the brass lands on the side of the head.

name: Sudden Haymaker
description: Bend the lead arm at a right angle and turn the hips to hook the brass under the ribs.

name: Bandarch Blow
description: Throw the fist up and over a raised guard so the brass drops onto the brow.

name: Descending Ringband
description: Dip the knees and drive the fist upward under the chin with the brass leading.

name: Skipping Overhand
description: Duck beneath a swinging blow and shift one foot wide to come up on the opponent's open flank.

name: Towing Palmbar
description: Hook the brass over the opponent's outstretched wrist and haul it down, spoiling the follow-up punch.

name: Hooding Knuckleridge
description: Roll the lead shoulder up so a hook slides off its slope while the rear brass fist waits.

name: Ringblow
description: Turn the whole body behind the hook so the metal-wrapped fist delivers its full weight in one blow.

name: Gnawing Brassring
description: Where there is no room to swing, jab the brass straight from the chest in a tight line.

name: Uppercut Hit
description: Lean a shoulder on the wall for leverage and bring the brass down in a short hammering arc.

name: Turning Studplate
description: Drive the shoulder into an opponent entering a narrow doorway so they stumble back before they set.

name: Swaying Knockout
description: Shuffle the feet sideways in small steps along a tight passage without crossing them.

name: Kept Knuckleplate
description: Crouch low with both brass fists forward so the crown of the head and face stay covered.

name: Firm Knockout
description: Rap the brass on a gripping knuckle, then weave on through the press of bodies.

name: Flat Uppercut
description: Send a thread of qi down the arm just before the straight punch so the brass lands harder.

name: Descending Haymaker
description: Warm the boss with a little qi, then press the jab so the point bites through cloth or leather.

name: Resting Fistbar
description: Coat the forearm in a thin rind of qi and let it knock the incoming fist away.

name: Light Handfill
description: Pull qi to the legs on an exhale and take a quick step clear of the incoming strike.

name: Knuckcowl
description: Hold the ringed fists before the face while a slow stream of qi keeps the forearms firm.

name: Locking Hooking
description: Tap the brass on the pulse point of the opponent's wrist to numb the hand and loosen its grip.

name: Narrow Knuckleplate
description: Land a rear cross, then let a second, qi-backed impact follow on the same spot a breath later.

name: Studdrop
description: Close the fist so the raised boss leads and press it hard into a gap in the opponent's guard.

name: Studstrike
description: Turn the fist over and drive the heel of the palm bar into the opponent's nose.

name: Planted Bandarch
description: Catch an incoming fist on the raised boss and roll it outward off the line of the face.

name: Knuckpause
description: Hook the palm bar under the opponent's wrist and lever it round to throw off their next blow.

name: Sideways Brassrim
description: Touch the boss to the opponent's guard as an anchor and slip around it to the outside.

name: Knuckdash
description: Breathe out sharply as the straight punch lands so qi flows into the brass at the moment of contact.

name: Ringpause
description: Draw a slow breath and settle the ringed fists before the face as the qi gathers in the forearms.

name: Slabdash
description: Hold the breath through a looping hook and release it on impact for a sudden jolt through the brass.

name: Light Palmbar
description: Let the exhale carry the body forward or back one quick pace while the fists stay up.

name: Knuckleridge Pause
description: Fill the chest and meet a punch with the braced forearm so the blow glances off the brass.

name: Short Ringband
description: Fire three light jabs on three short breaths, sending a thread of qi into the brass with each.

name: Slabcowl
description: Lower the shoulders on a long exhale and let the braced arms take pressure without shaking.

name: Stopping Knockout
description: Time a knuckle rap to the moment the opponent inhales, spoiling the movement they had begun.

name: Short Brassring
description: Throw a punch that travels no more than a hand's span, rooted in the legs and hips.

name: Studdash
description: Keep the elbow tucked as the rear fist crosses so the brass lands before the guard can close.

name: Studplate Wedge
description: Throw a rapid short punch onto the opponent's raised forearm to rattle the guard open.

name: Brawlbump
description: Sink an inch and drive a compact uppercut into the solar plexus with a thread of qi.

name: Knuckpace
description: Pivot on the lead foot a quarter turn so the opponent's straight blow passes the shoulder.

name: Studpause
description: Catch a punch on the forearm brass and return a short punch in the same motion.

name: Brawl Drop
description: Run a thread of qi from the shoulder down the arm and out to the ring as the punch lands.

name: Slabhit
description: Whip the arm from the shoulder in a loose arc and snap the brass tight at the end.

name: Folded Handfill
description: Keep a steady loop of qi circling both forearms while the fists hold the guard.

name: Easing Uppercut
description: Switch the circuit of qi to the legs for one gliding step, then return it to the fists.

name: Catching Brassrim
description: Tap the ring against the opponent's elbow as it begins to bend and interrupt their strike.

name: Resting Bandarch
description: Sweep the forearm in a small loop to turn a punch aside and bring the brass back to guard.

name: Single Brassrim
description: At the end of the circuit, jab with the boss so the whole of the qi runs to its single point.
